findings.diagnosis: The prompt undervalues keeping a short subject attached to its verb: it lets cuts isolate the verb (or verb phrase) from a immediately preceding short subject, producing orphaned predicates or apparent contradictions.
findings.evidence: ['en_us_767','en_us_432','en_us_1116','en_us_167','en_us_464']: each contains a short subject phrase immediately followed by a verb/copula; the policy splits subject from verb whereas the offline target joins them.
findings.type_predicate: A short (1–3-word) subject phrase (a proper name/pronoun or determiner + noun) is immediately followed by a verb or copula.

edit.text: Do not cut between a short (≤3-word) subject phrase (proper name, pronoun, or determiner+noun) and its immediately following verb or copula.
